name: Holly Hill Christmas Parade
paras: Holly Hill holds its 67th annual Christmas Parade on Saturday morning, December 5, with the theme Holly Jolly Hollydays. The Daytona Beach area tourism calendar lists it as free.
The parade begins on Ridgewood Avenue (US 1) at 5th Street and heads north, ending at Holly Hill City Hall. Both sides of US 1 close during the parade, so plan to walk in.
tip: Bring a comfortable chair or blanket and arrive early to claim a spot, as the host suggests.

name: Ponce Inlet Christmas Parade and Breakfast with Santa
address: 4670 S. Peninsula Dr., Ponce Inlet, FL
when_note: Breakfast with Santa at 9 AM, parade at 2 PM
paras: The Ponce Inlet Veterans Memorial Association hosts Breakfast with Santa at 9 AM at the Ponce Inlet Community Center. The listing says the $5 fee benefits the association, and the parade itself is free.
The annual Christmas Parade begins at 2 PM and heads north along South Peninsula Drive from Davies Park to Harbour Village Boulevard.
tip: The $5 fee covers breakfast only, so you can watch the parade without paying.

name: Panama City Christmas Parade
address: Harrison Ave, Downtown Panama City, FL
paras: The City of Panama City brings back its Downtown Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 5 at 6 PM. The city describes festive floats, marching groups and decorated vehicles rolling up Harrison Avenue.
The route runs from the Downtown City Marina up Harrison Avenue and into Tommy Oliver Stadium. Parade participation questions go to Parks, Culture and Recreation at (850) 872-3199.
tip: Santa is expected at the parade, so bring the little ones who want to wave.

name: Christmas at Harders Park
address: 8110 John Pitts Road, Panama City, FL 32401
when_note: Santa arrives by helicopter at 4:30 PM, weather permitting
paras: Bay County Parks and Recreation hosts its free, family-friendly Christmas at Harders Park on Saturday, December 12 from 4 to 8 PM. Kids get photos with Santa, free face painting, a snow area and a station to write letters to Santa.
Santa is scheduled to make an entrance at 4:30 PM aboard a Bay County Sheriff's Office helicopter, weather permitting. Food trucks sell food and refreshments on site.
tip: Bring a camera for the 4:30 PM helicopter arrival, since the host says families will want photos.

name: Fairgrounds Festival of Lights Drive-Thru
address: 15601 West Midway Road, Fort Pierce, FL 34945
when_note: Wed, Thu and Sun 6 to 9 PM; Fri and Sat 6 to 10 PM; open nightly Dec 16 to 27
paras: The St. Lucie County Fair Association runs its Festival of Lights as a drive-thru holiday light display at the fairgrounds, from Thanksgiving night through December 27. Admission is $35 per car load.
The host's page pairs the lights with interactive Christmas fun, food and family photos. Hours are 6 to 9 PM Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday and 6 to 10 PM Friday and Saturday.
tip: Tickets are sold online through the fair's ticket page, so check there before you drive out.

name: St. Lucie County Christmas Boat Parade
paras: The Fort Pierce Yacht Club lists the St. Lucie County Christmas Boat Parade for Saturday, December 12 at 6 PM, and shows it as free. Decorated boats start just north of the Fort Pierce North Bridge and head south past the Village Green.
The host's viewing list includes Causeway Park at 2000 Seaway Dr in Fort Pierce, plus spots in Stuart and Jensen Beach along the route.
tip: Causeway Park is the Fort Pierce viewing spot on the host's list.

name: Stuart Christmas Parade
paras: The 65th annual Stuart Christmas Parade is set for Friday, December 4 at 7 PM, with the 2026 theme Santa's Stuart Vacation. The parade site calls it a Martin County tradition since 1960.
The site does not post a route or a price, and parades on public streets are free to watch.
tip: Check the parade site closer to the date for the route before choosing a spot.

name: Christmas on Main and Stuart Tree Lighting
address: Riverwalk Stage, Historic Downtown Stuart, FL
paras: Stuart Main Street kicks off the season on Friday, November 27 from 4 to 7 PM with free admission. The host lists snowfall in Historic Downtown Stuart, DIY photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and Santa's sleigh rides.
The evening also has live holiday music and performances, festive arts and crafts, cookies and cocoa, and local food.
tip: Plan to stay for the tree lighting, which the event title says is part of the evening.

name: Holidays on Central
address: Central Park, Downtown Winter Haven, FL
paras: Holidays on Central fills Central Park in Downtown Winter Haven on Saturday, December 5 from 10 AM to 4 PM. The listing mentions more than 100 local vendors, live entertainment on the BayCare stage and food trucks.
Families get free photos with Santa, a complimentary photo booth and a kids craft tent hosted by Heartland Church. An information booth hands out festive giveaways such as ornaments and craft kits.
tip: Stop by the information booth for the giveaways the host lists.

name: Downtown Saturday Matinee: The Polar Express
venue: Winter Haven Public Library, Multipurpose Room
address: 325 Ave A NW, Winter Haven, FL 33881
paras: The City of Winter Haven's Saturday Matinee series shows The Polar Express (rated G) on December 19 from 2 to 4 PM in the Winter Haven Public Library Multipurpose Room.
The calendar describes the film as a holiday tale of a young boy who doubts Santa exists until a magical train appears on Christmas Eve.
tip: It is an indoor showing, a good pick if the weather turns.
